faqs.question: What products are available in the bakery?
faqs.answer: We offer cakes, pastries, breads, cookies, snacks, desserts, beverages, and customized bakery items.

faqs.question: What are your bakery opening hours?
faqs.answer: Bakery timings vary depending on location and business hours.

faqs.question: Is the bakery open on holidays?
faqs.answer: Yes, the bakery may remain open on holidays depending on the schedule.

faqs.question: Can I order cakes in advance?
faqs.answer: Yes, cakes can be pre-ordered through phone, WhatsApp, website, or direct visit.

faqs.question: Do you make customized cakes?
faqs.answer: Yes, customized cakes are available for birthdays, weddings, anniversaries, and special occasions.

faqs.question: Do you provide photo cakes?
faqs.answer: Yes, photo cakes can be prepared based on customer requirements.

faqs.question: Can you prepare theme cakes?
faqs.answer: Yes, theme cakes are available for kids, parties, and special events.

faqs.question: Do you have eggless cakes?
faqs.answer: Yes, eggless cakes and pastries are available.

faqs.question: What cake flavours are available?
faqs.answer: Chocolate, vanilla, butterscotch, red velvet, black forest, white forest, fruit, and other flavours are available.

faqs.question: What cake sizes are available?
faqs.answer: Different cake sizes are available depending on serving requirements.

faqs.question: Can I get same-day cake delivery?
faqs.answer: Same-day delivery may be available depending on cake type and availability.

faqs.question: Do you provide cake delivery?
faqs.answer: Yes, home delivery services are available for cakes and selected products.

faqs.question: Is delivery available in my area?
faqs.answer: Delivery availability depends on your location and service area.

faqs.question: How long does delivery take?
faqs.answer: Delivery time depends on order size, traffic, and delivery location.

faqs.question: Can I order bakery items online?
faqs.answer: Yes, orders can be placed through website, app, WhatsApp, or phone.

faqs.question: What payment methods are accepted?
faqs.answer: We accept cash, cards, UPI, wallets, and online payments.

faqs.question: Do you accept UPI payments?
faqs.answer: Yes, all major UPI payment apps are accepted.

faqs.question: Do you provide offers or discounts?
faqs.answer: Yes, seasonal offers, combo deals, and special discounts may be available.

faqs.question: Do you provide birthday party packages?
faqs.answer: Yes, birthday packages with cakes, snacks, and decorations may be available.

faqs.question: Do you sell snacks and fast food items?
faqs.answer: Yes, puffs, sandwiches, rolls, burgers, pizza, and other snacks are available.

faqs.question: Do you provide beverages?
faqs.answer: Yes, tea, coffee, juices, soft drinks, and other beverages are available.

faqs.question: Do you sell fresh bread?
faqs.answer: Yes, fresh bread and buns are prepared daily.

faqs.question: Do you have cookies and biscuits?
faqs.answer: Yes, a variety of cookies, biscuits, and baked snacks are available.

faqs.question: Do you accept bulk orders?
faqs.answer: Yes, bulk orders for events and functions are accepted.

faqs.question: Do you provide bakery catering for events?
faqs.answer: Yes, bakery catering services may be available for parties and events.

faqs.question: Are bakery products freshly prepared?
faqs.answer: Yes, products are freshly prepared and packed hygienically.

faqs.question: Can I return bakery products?
faqs.answer: Returns or exchanges depend on product condition and bakery policy.

faqs.question: Is parking available at the bakery?
faqs.answer: Parking availability depends on bakery location.

faqs.question: Do you have seating facilities?
faqs.answer: Some bakery locations may provide dine-in seating facilities.

faqs.question: Do you provide WiFi for customers?
faqs.answer: WiFi availability depends on bakery facilities.

faqs.question: How can I contact the bakery?
faqs.answer: You can contact us through phone, WhatsApp, email, or direct visit.
